pages.en:
—There is no time to hesitate.

If this bounded field was raised by Shinji's Servant, then we have only one choice: find the source and force them to stop it as quickly as possible…!

立ち止まっている遠坂の手を引いて走り出す。

pages.en:
“Tohsaka, let's split up and search the school. We can't allow anyone else to become a victim…!”

I seize the motionless Tohsaka by the hand and break into a run.

pages.ja: 「ま、待って衛宮くん、それじゃきっと間に合わない……！ 相手がサーヴァントならこっちもサーヴァントを出さないと、慎二を探し出したところで返り討ちになるだけよ」
pages.jaRuby: 「ま、待って衛宮くん、それじゃきっと間に合わない……！ 相手がサーヴァントならこっちもサーヴァントを出さないと、慎二を探し出したところで返り討ちになるだけよ」
pages.en: “W-wait, Emiya. We would never make it in time that way…! If the enemy is a Servant, we need a Servant of our own. Even if we find Shinji, they'll only turn the tables on us.”

ぎり、と唇を噛んで遠坂は言う。
気を取り直したように見えるが、まだ本来の冷静さは戻っていない。

pages.en:
“Use a Command Spell. I'll call Archer too. With Command Spells, we can bring them both here at once.”

Tohsaka bites her lip as she speaks.

She appears to have pulled herself together, but her usual composure has not yet returned.

pages.ja:
「
待った。令呪を使うなら俺だけでいい。敵は一人だろ、ならセイバー一人で十分だ」
……それに。
これが慎二のサーヴァントの仕業なら、相手はあの黒いサーヴァントだ。
あいつとは一昨日戦った。あのサーヴァントが相手なら、セイバーは確実に勝利できる

“—Wait. If we're using Command Spells, mine will be enough. There is only one enemy. Saber can handle one Servant herself.”

…Besides.

If Shinji's Servant is responsible, our opponent will be that black-clad Servant.

We fought her the day before yesterday. Against that Servant, Saber is certain to win——

pages.ja:
「衛宮くん、いいの……？」
「ああ。遠坂は昨日令呪を使ったんだろ。なら今度は俺の番だ。セイバーを呼んでもどうにもならないなら、その時はアーチャーを呼べばいい。
それで、令呪の使い方は！？」

それで、令呪の使い方は！？」
pages.en:
“Emiya, are you sure…?”

“Yeah. You used a Command Spell yesterday, didn't you? Then this time it's my turn. I'll summon Saber first. If even she can't handle it, you can call Archer then.

“—Now, how do I use a Command Spell!?”

pages.ja: 「……左手に意識を固めて。目は瞑った方がいい。頭の中で自分の令呪の形をイメージして、するっと紐解くだけでいいわ。もちろん、解く時は命令をしながらよ」
pages.jaRuby: 「……左手に意識を固めて。目は瞑った方がいい。頭の中で自分の令呪の形をイメージして、するっと紐解くだけでいいわ。もちろん、解く時は命令をしながらよ」
pages.en: “…Concentrate your awareness in your left hand. It will be easier with your eyes closed. Picture the shape of your Command Spell in your mind, then simply let it unravel. And as you release it, speak your command.”

pages.ja:

時間はかけられない。
最短で雑念をクリアし、
二つ目の画に手をかけ、
「
頼む。来い、セイバー
！！！！」
躊躇う事なく、左手の令呪を解放した。

pages.en:
I close my eyes.

There is no time to waste.

In the briefest instant, I clear my mind of every stray thought,

reach for the second stroke,

and—

“—Please. Come to me, Saber——!”

without hesitation, release the Command Spell upon my left hand.

The back of my left hand burns fiercely.

At the same moment, I sense an unnatural weight directly beside me—and from that dense distortion emerges a knight in silver.

“I answer your summons. Master, what has happened…? If you spent a Command Spell, the need must be dire.”

pages.en: “What—? No, I trust your ability to detect a Servant, but that doesn't make sense. I can feel the anchor of the bounded field on the first floor. As a Servant, you're better at detecting other Servants than I am, but when it comes to traces of magecraft, I am no less capable.”

“…? The Servant is on this floor, but the bounded field originates on the first. Is that what you're saying, Tohsaka?”

“I… can't say for certain, but that is what I sense.

“The anchor of this bounded field is on the first floor.”
